resolution.note: test/cli/lane-start-held-record.test.ts: real-git lane start keeps the record visible to krn task list (exit 0), publish skips it, hold lapses on base change or lane removal; fast related tests pass

title: a task record published into a lane stays visible to main readers until it merges
body:
Evidence: 2026-11-21 `krn task list` in the main checkout exits non-zero with `pending tasks/t-1ntztra.json: unknown after task "t-fcd2sbc"` (also t-gkwtsx7). refs/krn/pending-tasks log: `99b39d7 published t-fcd2sbc` when lane arm-interleave started; the record now lives only in that lane worktree, while pending dependents still name it (src/task/store.ts:267). Same for t-p6fqmfb and t-bc3m6hf (published by lane start).
Outcome: a pending record published into a lane stays visible to every main-checkout reader (list, show, ready, dependents) until origin/<base> carries it; `krn task list` exits 0 with a pending dependent of a lane-published task; `krn task publish` never ships a record a lane already carries.
Proof: real-git test: create A and B (after A) pending, `krn lane start --task A`, then `krn task list` exits 0 and shows A and B; after A's lane merges, the next write drops the pending copy.
Files: src/task/pending.ts, src/task/storage.ts, src/task/store.ts, src/cli/lane.ts (start publish step only), test/task/
